import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.03, "lr": 0.0005}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32

        super().__init__()

        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

        res = []

                mx, mn, av = p, p, p

                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)

        self.gproj = nn.Linear(64, WIDTH)

        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.done_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.1))
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))

    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "ent_coef": 0.03, "lr": 0.0007, "gamma": 0.97, "n_minibatches": 32}

STEM = 64
WIDTH = 48
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1, dilation=1),
            nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=2, dilation=2),
            nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1, dilation=1)])
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.done_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.1))
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        f = self.stem(obs)
        for c in self.convs:
            f = F.relu(f + c(f))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        done = self.done_head(g) * self.done_scale
        logits = torch.cat([place, done], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class FlipPoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (dx - 1, 0, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        o = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        o = torch.flip(o, dims=[3])
        return o.flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = FlipPoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)

            res.append(out(h))

            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1, dilation=1),
            nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=2, dilation=2),
            nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1, dilation=1)])

        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

trials.name: Orientation-agnostic pooled head
trials.hypothesis: Does not assume which axis is mirrored. For each of four orientations (none, flip x, flip y, flip both), footprint pooling is anchored at the matching corner and the result is flipped back into action coordinates. All four go into one learned mix, which can pick the right orientation from the reward. Refuted if it is much worse than the explicit x-flip candidate. That would mean learning which orientation to use is costly, and the explicit flip should be preferred.

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 16
HID = 32

ORIENTS = [(False, False), (False, True), (True, False), (True, True)]


class OrientPoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        n_in = 3 * proj * len(ORIENTS)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(n_in, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def pooled(self, p, dy, dx, fy, fx):
        if dy * dx == 1:
            t = torch.cat([p, p, p], dim=1)
        else:
            left = dx - 1 if fx else 0
            right = 0 if fx else dx - 1
            top = dy - 1 if fy else 0
            bottom = 0 if fy else dy - 1
            q = F.pad(p, (left, right, top, bottom))
            mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            t = torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)
        if fy and fx:
            t = torch.flip(t, dims=[2, 3])
        elif fy:
            t = torch.flip(t, dims=[2])
        elif fx:
            t = torch.flip(t, dims=[3])
        return t

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            feats = [self.pooled(p, dy, dx, fy, fx) for fy, fx in ORIENTS]
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat(feats, dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = OrientPoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

class FlipPoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (dx - 1, 0, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        o = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        o = torch.flip(o, dims=[3])
        return o.flatten(1)

    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = FlipPoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class FlipPoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (dx - 1, 0, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        o = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        o = torch.flip(o, dims=[3])
        return o.flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = FlipPoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

A gate, computed from the pooled features of layer z and the layer below, takes a softmax over z to estimate the landing layer and weights a per-layer score by it. That score is added to r2c1's logit. This lets the network check whether the target has exactly those cells at the landing layer. It uses 3 epochs to keep about 120k samples. import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 3}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
LD = 12
LHID = 16


def foot_pool(p, dy, dx):
    if dy * dx == 1:
        return torch.cat([p, p, p], dim=1)
    q = F.pad(p, (dx - 1, 0, 0, dy - 1))
    mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
    mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
    av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
    return torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)

    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            h = F.relu(mix(foot_pool(p, dy, dx)))
            res.append(out(h))
        o = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        return torch.flip(o, dims=[3])

        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.d = d
        self.inp = nn.Conv2d(4 + self.Z + 3, d, 1)
        self.fproj = nn.Conv2d(fdim, d, 1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(d, d, 1)
        self.vmix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * d, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.vout = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.gate = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(6 * d, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, obs, f):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        occ = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X).permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4)
        col = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)

        h = self.inp(x).view(B, Z, self.d, Y, X) + self.fproj(f).unsqueeze(1)

            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = FlipPoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.lhead = LayerHead(spec, WIDTH, LD, LHID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class FlipPoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (dx - 1, 0, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        o = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        o = torch.flip(o, dims=[3])
        return o.flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = FlipPoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class FlipPoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (dx - 1, 0, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        o = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        o = torch.flip(o, dims=[3])
        return o.flatten(1)

        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = FlipPoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))

analyses.2: All four trials, including the baseline, collapsed straight to DONE. Neither recipe changes nor damping the DONE logit helped. The untrained traces show why: the action's column is mirrored. For example, '1x1 at col 2' filled col 5, and '1x2 at col 6' filled cols 0 and 1. Rows are not affected. So the brick actually covers columns X-dx-x to X-1-x. A translation-equivariant conv head scores the anchor using features at the wrong place, so it cannot learn which placements fill missing cells. Most placements then score below DONE's 0 reward, and DONE wins. The target heights the agent observes match the design, so the observation looks correct. The fix is architectural: re-index the placement logits so each one reads features from the cells the brick will actually fill. That is a flip after the learned layers, which the rules allow. One candidate tests the plain fix and one adds capacity. The third adds a general head that can pick any axis mirror, as a hedge in case other worlds remap actions differently.
analyses.3: This world mirrors the x-axis: placing at action column x fills cells X-dx-x to X-1-x. Every head that assumed no mirror collapsed to DONE (0.000). With the explicit x-flip, r2c1 reached 0.65 (seeds 0.56 and 0.75). The four-orientation head that had to learn the flip got 0.48, and the deeper r2c2 got 0.35. That r2c2 run also changed the recipe (2 epochs, gamma 0.97), so its result does not test either change cleanly. r2c1's training success was still rising at the end (0.28 at 75%, 0.46 at 100%), so it may be short of samples. Its remaining mistakes are about order and layers: it places a cell on the wrong layer, buries cells under a stack, or stops before finishing. This round tests three things against r2c1: more samples through fewer epochs, a longer credit horizon, and a head that reasons about which layer a brick lands on.
analyses.4: Every trial without the x-mirrored footprint head collapsed to an immediate DONE and scored 0. With the mirror, the task is learnable. The biggest gain so far came from more samples: dropping from 4 PPO epochs to 2 roughly doubled the samples and moved dev success from 0.65 to 0.90 (seeds 0.94 and 0.86), well beyond the ~0.2 seed spread. A longer credit horizon (0.62), landing-layer attention (0.59), a deeper dilated net (0.35) and the orientation-agnostic head (0.48) all scored at or below the mirrored baseline. r3c1's training success levelled off near 0.87 from 75% of training onward, and its dev IoU is 0.99, so the remaining failures are small ordering or completion errors. For the last round I keep the r3c1 network. I test 1 PPO epoch (about 400k samples), 1 epoch with smaller minibatches (more gradient steps), and a wider trunk at 1 epoch, which keeps about r3c1's sample count and tests whether capacity is the limit.
